barrier_type.description: The type of equity barrier, such as 'Digital Divide', 'Language Access', or 'Time Poverty'.

excluded_groups.description: The specific population groups that are disproportionately affected by this barrier.

evidence.description: Supporting data or the source for this barrier, such as 'Richmond's Language Access Plan' or 'Digital Equity statistics'.

city_name.description: The name of the comparable city and state (e.g., 'Pittsburgh, PA').

solution_name.description: The name of the city's tool or portal (e.g., 'OneStopPGH Insights').

key_features.description: A summary of the tool's main features, such as interactive maps, unified data dashboards, or public comment portals.

url.description: The direct URL to the solution for reference.

comparable_city_solutions.description: Provides examples of how comparable US cities have addressed similar problems, including details on their map-based tools and unified development portals. Each city will be a separate entry in the array.
